meta.title: Aim Trainer - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Practice and improve your mouse aim. Click targets as fast and accurately as possible. 30 second challenge.
aimDesc: Click targets as quickly as possible. You have {duration} seconds — one target at a time.
steps_aim-trainer_1Desc: Choose target size, spawn rate, and session duration. Start with larger targets and slower spawns if you're new to aim training.
steps_aim-trainer_2Desc: Click each target as quickly as possible as they appear. Your accuracy, hits per second, and total score track in real time.
steps_aim-trainer_3Desc: View your final score, accuracy percentage, and hit count. Track improvement over multiple sessions. Consistent daily practice yields the best results.
desc: Practice and improve your mouse aim. Click targets as fast and accurately as possible. 30 second challenge.
